claims: The TCU Horned Frogs represent Texas Christian University in Fort Worth, TX.
The TCU Horned Frogs compete in NCAA Division I.
The TCU Horned Frogs are members of the Big 12 Conference.
TCU's mascot is based on the Texas horned lizard.
Texas Christian University supports 22 varsity sports.
TCU Athletics are located in Fort Worth, Texas.
TCU joined the Big 12 Conference in 2012.
The horned lizard was selected as the mascot in 1897.
The horned lizard was selected as the mascot to represent the school's nickname 'small but mighty'.
The horned lizard was selected as the mascot following a football game where they covered the field.
TCU football plays at Amon G. Carter Stadium.
TCU football has a tradition since 1896.
The TCU men's basketball team is active in the 2026 NCAA tournament.
The TCU men's basketball team had a first-round win over Ohio State.
The 'Horned Frog' salute involves a curled-finger, protruding-knuckle salute.
The 'Horned Frog' salute is meant to mimic the creature's horns.
The 'Athletic Frog' is specifically for sports.
The 'Athletic Frog' is often used with the arched TCU logo.
